purpose: Teach: ソヴィエト/マオリ/秦/劉/宋/萬/鵐/カキ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、ソヴィエト連邦時代の経済史研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, your paper covered the economic history of the Soviet era, didn't it?
lines.style: Steady, genuinely curious. Slight pause before the question, as if reviewing notes. Warm but professional — the teacher who's actually read your work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、ニュージーランドのマオリ文化研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — my paper was actually about Maori cultural research in New Zealand.
lines.style: Clear, matter-of-fact correction. No defensiveness, just precision. The quiet confidence of someone who knows what they wrote.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 中国古代の秦王朝の制度研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your paper dealt with institutional studies of China's ancient Qin dynasty, then?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly searching tone. Gentle reprasing, as if double-checking her memory. Patient — not accusatory, just confirming.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、漢の劉邦、つまり劉氏王朝の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — actually, my research focused on the Han dynasty under Liu Bang, the Liu imperial line.
lines.style: Patient but precise. Tone doesn't shift despite the correction. She's setting the record straight without making it awkward.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 宋朝の文芸復興の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your paper explored the cultural renaissance during the Song dynasty, correct?
lines.style: Gentle inquiry, slightly tentative. The measured pace of someone reconsidering. Open to being wrong — genuinely interested in the actual answer.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、旧字「萬」、つまり万の使われ方の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — my paper actually examined the usage of the archaic character for 'ten thousand,' the traditional form of 万.
lines.style: Calm, specific. No impatience in her tone. She's used to clarifying and does it without edge. The student who knows her own work inside out.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 希少鳥類の鵐、つまり鵐属の分類研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your research covered the classification of rare birds — the genus of bunting species, wasn't it?
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful. A pause before the final phrase. The tone of someone genuinely trying to get it right this time, a little humbled.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、養殖業の牡蠣、つまりカキの生態研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — my paper focused on the ecological research of cultivated oysters, their lifecycle and behavior.
lines.style: Calm, final correction. She's said what needs saying. Slightly warmer now, perhaps a hint of relief that they've cleared the air. No frustration audible.
